channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Twin Cities tiny homes on the market for budget-conscious buyers
item.description: From small single-family houses to efficient condos, there are several affordable options around Minnesota for prospective homeowners.

item.title: No. 3 Gophers women’s hockey beats top-ranked Wisconsin 3-2 in overtime
item.description: Molly Jordan scored 4-on-4 after a Gophers power play expired for her team’s 11th consecutive victory.

item.title: Scoggins: Kwesi Adofo-Mensah’s draft failures led to Vikings GM’s ouster
item.description: The Vikings’ struggles to add young impact players forced the team to spend heavily in free agency the past few years.

item.title: Bar Brava closes indefinitely after fallout from owner’s social media posts
item.description: Tensions bubbled over after Dan Rice made comments linking the Somali community and crime that led its chef in residence to leave.

item.title: Maddyn Greenway joins 5,000-point club, becoming third girls basketball player to accomplish feat
item.description: The Providence Academy senior surpassed the milestone against Blake on Friday, Jan. 30.

item.title: Natural gas prices more than 15 times higher than expected due to frigid weather
item.description: Temperatures should warm throughout the Midwest next week, but energy bills are likely to cause grief.

item.title: Border Patrol agent is arrested, accused of drunken driving in Twin Cities
item.description: Vomit-covered federal agent’s vehicle was stopped in front of a no parking sign shortly before 3:30 a.m., according to the charges.

item.title: Minnesota law professors call arrests of journalists for documenting church protest an attack on free press
item.description: Georgia Fort and Don Lemon were arrested nearly two weeks after the demonstration at Cities Church in St. Paul.

item.title: St. Paul Police Department denies data requests about confrontation with protesters
item.description: An ICE raid in November on St. Paul’s East Side drew protesters, who clashed with city police.

item.title: The latest: Protests in Minneapolis, across country Friday as ICE pushback mounts
item.description: Protesters marched in streets, students walked out of school and businesses shut their doors around the U.S. to show support for Minnesota.
